title: NBA Offseason Daily Digest
subtitle: September 10, 2026: Trade Drama, Roster Moves & Off-Court Action

items.headline: Kawhi Leonard Trade in Doubt Amid Clippers' Penalties; Antetokounmpo to Heat Finalized
items.summary: Questions are emerging around the delayed Kawhi Leonard trade, which remains unofficial weeks after an agreement, stemming from the NBA's historic penalties against the Clippers for salary cap circumvention. The league has stripped the Clippers of five draft picks, issued a $30M fine, and suspended owner Steve Ballmer for one year. Leonard is reportedly heading back to Toronto. Meanwhile, Giannis Antetokounmpo's trade from the Milwaukee Bucks to the Miami Heat has been finalized, with the superstar reportedly purchasing a $13.5M mansion in Miami.

items.headline: DeMar DeRozan Deal with Nuggets Now Official
items.summary: Veteran guard DeMar DeRozan's agreement with the Denver Nuggets has officially been recorded in the NBA's transaction log, finalizing a key offseason roster move for the reigning champions.

items.headline: Timberwolves' Draft Pick Trey Kaufman-Renn Receives NCAA Restraining Order
items.summary: Trey Kaufman-Renn, the Minnesota Timberwolves' 59th overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, has been granted a temporary restraining order against the NCAA. This allows him to join a college team, though he will not be returning to Purdue.

items.headline: Alex Toohey Returns to Warriors on Exhibit 10 Deal
items.summary: Alex Toohey, a 2025 second-round pick, is rejoining the Golden State Warriors for training camp on an Exhibit 10 contract. The 6'7" Australian forward, who missed last season due to injury, also participated in the Warriors' Summer League.

items.headline: Pelicans Waive Veteran Forward Taj Gibson
items.summary: The New Orleans Pelicans have waived veteran forward Taj Gibson, a move that provides them with more roster flexibility as the offseason progresses.

items.headline: Lakers Set to Hire Heat's Eric Amsler as Assistant GM
items.summary: The Los Angeles Lakers are reportedly set to bolster their front office by hiring Eric Amsler from the Miami Heat as their new Assistant General Manager.

items.headline: Jaylen Brown Spars in Boxing Ring During Africa Trip
items.summary: Philadelphia 76ers star Jaylen Brown, currently on his 7uice Foundation tour in Nigeria, unexpectedly participated in a spontaneous boxing sparring session, creating viral social media content during his offseason charity mission.

items.headline: Glen Davis Claims Clippers Cost Him Four Seasons and $30M
items.summary: Former NBA champion Glen Davis alleges the Clippers' failure to properly diagnose a broken foot prematurely ended his career at age 29, costing him four NBA seasons and $30 million.

items.headline: Paul and Westbrook Vacation Together Post-Retirement
items.summary: Just months after announcing their retirements from the NBA, former star guards Chris Paul and Russell Westbrook were seen vacationing together in Portofino, Italy.
